{{Quote|It commemorates Gavail Kespan. He died defending the capital during the Wanderers' Siege.|Nadia Grell|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''Sarkhai's capital city''' was the capital of the planet [[Sarkhai/Legends|Sarkhai]]. During the [[Wanderers' Siege]] the [[Sarkhai (species)/Legends|Sarkhai]] [[Gavail Kespan]] fought to defend the city and gave his life during the conflict. The [[Annex of Kespan]] was built to commemorate his sacrifice.<ref name="TOR" />
